column2: # This section extends ECB data to match the NFC sample period, creates a continuous daily timeline, carries policy rates forward between ECB announcements, and then aggregates these observations into monthly averages.
# Get the latest month available in the NFC dataset
# Convert ECB policy-rate data to monthly frequency
DATE = seq.Date(min(DATE, na.rm = TRUE), max_nfc_date, by = "day")
# Carry policy rates forward between ECB changes
# Aggregate daily values into monthly averages
mutate(month = floor_date(DATE, "month")) %>% #Takes each date and rounds it down to the first day of its month
group_by(month) %>%                           #Group all observations that belong to the same month together

ECBRate = mean(ECB_RATE, na.rm = TRUE),     #Convert daily ECB observations into a monthly series that can be merged with                                                       monthly NFC lending data.
